resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Increment Operators[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

[b][/b]An [b]increment [/b]or [b]decrement [/b]operator provides a more convenient and compact way to increase or decrease the value of a variable by [b]one[/b]. 
For example, the statement [b]x=x+1;[/b] can be simplified to [b]++x;[/b] 
[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="java" codeId="720"]int test = 5;
++test; // test is now 6[/code]
The [b]decrement [/b]operator (--) is used to decrease the value of a variable by one. [code format="java" codeId="721"]int test = 5;
--test; // test is now 4[/code]
[note]Use this operator with caution to avoid calculation mistakes.[/note]

resolved.title: 前缀和后缀
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Prefix & Postfix[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Two forms, [b]prefix [/b]and [b]postfix[/b], may be used with both the increment and decrement operators.
With prefix form, the operator appears before the operand, while in postfix form, the operator appears after the operand. Below is an explanation of how the two forms work:
[b]Prefix[/b]: Increments the variable's value and uses the new value in the expression. 
[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="java" codeId="722"]int x = 34;
int y = [b]++x[/b]; // y is 35[/code]
The value of x is first incremented to 35, and is then assigned to y, so the values of both x and y are now 35.
[b]Postfix[/b]: The variable's value is first used in the expression and is then increased. 
[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="java" codeId="723"]int x = 34;
int y = [b]x++[/b]; // y is 34[/code]
x is first assigned to y, and is then incremented by one. Therefore, x becomes 35, while y is assigned the value of 34.
[note]The same applies to the [b]decrement [/b]operator.[/note]

在自增`++`和自减`--`运算符中，有两种形式: **前缀**和**后缀**。

在前缀形式下，运算符出现在操作数之前，而后缀形式下，运算符出现在操作数之后。

下面是对这两种形式工作原理的解释：
**前缀**：先增加变量的值，然后再在表达式中使用该变量新的值。
**举例：**

resolved.title: 游戏得分
resolved.problem_statement_md:
小明和小李正在玩一个棋盘游戏，双方开始的点数相同。
比如小明赢了第一局，得到1分，而小李输了这局，失去了1分。

给定的程序是将初始双方的分数，将小明的分数增加1，将小李的分数减少1。
但有一点不对：程序输出的分数没有变化。

请修复程序，使其产生预期的输出结果。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Increment & Decrement[/h1][/s0l0!-header]
Tom and Bob are playing a board game, in which both players start with the same number of points. Tom won the first game and got 1 point, while Bob lost the game, and therefore lost 1 point.

You are given a program that is intended to take the initial score and increase Tom's score by 1 and decrease Bob's score by 1.
But something is wrong: the program outputs the scores without the change.

[b]Task[/b]
Fix the program to result in the expected outputs.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
5

[b]Sample Output[/b]
Round 1 results:[b] [/b]
6
4

[b]Explanation[/b]
Both players had 5 points at the start of the game. After the first game, Tom gained 1 point (6, the first outputted number), and Bob lost 1 point (4, the second outputted number).
[note]Remember the difference between prefix and postfix operators. It will help you a lot in this task. [/note]
resolved.hint_md: 记住前缀和后缀运算符之间的区别，这对你完成这项任务有很大帮助。
